summary: GameStop Corp. (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting that Chairman/CEO Ryan Cohen requested withdrawal of a proposed CEO Performance Award from its proxy statement to fully focus on the proposed acquisition of eBay Inc. No terms (price per share, premium, or valuation) were disclosed in this filing. The board granted the request; no advisor named. The filing notes GameStop will release additional materials on the eBay acquisition, including strategic rationale and operational plan. What to watch: emergence of a definitive agreement, regulatory timeline, and financing details to assess deal feasibility and risk-arb spread.
